definitions.gloss: baggage storage; left-luggage service or counter
definitions.explanation: A service that holds luggage for a while, or the counter where it is handed over — at a station, hotel, museum, or event venue. Also written {荷物|にもつ}{預|あず}かり{所|じょ} when the place itself is meant.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}{預|あず}かりはありますか。
チェックアウト{後|ご}も{荷物|にもつ}{預|あず}かりを{利用|りよう}できます。
examples.english: You can use the baggage storage even after checking out.

examples.japanese: コインロッカーが{全部|ぜんぶ}{埋|う}まっていたので、{駅|えき}の{荷物|にもつ}{預|あず}かりにスーツケースを{置|お}いてきた。
examples.english: All the coin lockers were full, so I left my suitcase at the station's baggage storage.

notes:
{荷物|にもつ} (luggage) plus the noun form of {預|あず}かる (to keep something for someone). Seen on signs and on hotel and station websites; a traveler will meet it constantly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷物|にもつ}{預|あず}かり{所|じょ}: baggage storage room
- {荷物|にもつ}{預|あず}かりサービス: baggage-holding service
- {荷物|にもつ}{預|あず}かりを{利用|りよう}する: to use the baggage storage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- コインロッカー: coin locker — a self-service locker, not a staffed counter
- {手荷物|てにもつ}{一時|いちじ}{預|あず}かり{所|じょ}: short-term baggage check — the fuller signage form used at large stations
